pages.text:
MARA RIVER CAMP
KENYA
Perched on a graceful bend of the Mara River at the
foot of the Oloololo Escarpment, Exploreans Mara
River Camp offers a front-row seat to one of the
greatest spectacles on Earth. Here, the boundaries
between comfort and the raw African wilderness
dissolve, providing an intimate safari experience that is
as authentic as it is comfortable.
Because it sits directly on the river, you don’t even have
to leave the camp to see animals. Elephants, giraffes, and
monkeys are frequent visitors to the grounds.
Its proximity to the Mara River makes it a prime spot
during the Great Migration (July–October), as it’s near
several major crossing points.
About a 15-minute drive from the Kichwa Tembo
Airstrip.

EXPLOREANS
Mara River Camp - Masai Mara
DINING & DRINKS
Restaurant:
Your day begins with a refined continental breakfast providing
the perfect start to your morning. As the day unfolds, join us for
Lunch, where you can choose between an expansive, ever-changing
buffet or a curated A’la carte menu for a more tailored experience.
Whether you prefer the lush serenity of our garden or the open-air
breeze of our deck setups, every meal is served with an atmosphere
as exceptional as the food itself.
Zebra bar:
Open daily until bedtime, it’s the heart of our social scene. Enjoy
refreshing drinks delivered right to your side at the swimming pool,
or gather as the stars come out for a nightcap by the crackling
open-air bonfire. From your first coffee to your last cocktail by the
fire, we have every moment covered.
